headline: 12 dead as private plane crashes in Missouri
summary: The victims include 11 skydivers and a pilot. The aircraft failed to gain altitude after takeoff from Butler Memorial Airport.
details: Eleven skydivers and a pilot were killed when a private plane crashed on Sunday in Butler, Missouri, according to the aircraft operator, Skydive Kansas City.
The Missouri State Highway Patrol reported that the crash occurred near the Butler Memorial Airport, approximately 60 miles south of Kansas City.

The single-engine turboprop airplane, identified as a Pacific Aerospace 750XL, took off around 11:20 am CT but failed to gain altitude before making a sharp left turn and crashing about 300 yards from the runway.
Bates County Sheriff Chad Anderson stated that the incident appeared to be an accident and noted that family members of the victims witnessed the crash.
The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is investigating the cause of the crash, with a final report expected in 12 to 24 months.
Missouri Governor Mike Kehoe expressed his grief and mentioned that state agencies, including grief counselors, are providing support to the surviving family members.
According to the US Parachute Association, there were 16 skydiving-related fatalities in the US last year out of an estimated 3.5 million jumps.
caption:
12 people, including 11 skydivers, killed in a Missouri plane crash.

Eleven skydivers and a pilot were killed when a private plane crashed on Sunday in Butler, Missouri, according to the aircraft operator, Skydive Kansas City.

The Missouri State Highway Patrol reported that the crash occurred near the Butler Memorial Airport, approximately 60 miles south of Kansas City.

The single-engine turboprop airplane, identified as a Pacific Aerospace 750XL, took off around 11:20 am CT but failed to gain altitude before making a sharp left turn and crashing about 300 yards from the runway.

Bates County Sheriff Chad Anderson stated that the incident appeared to be an accident and noted that family members of the victims witnessed the crash.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is investigating the cause of the crash, with a final report expected in 12 to 24 months.

Missouri Governor Mike Kehoe expressed his grief and mentioned that state agencies, including grief counselors, are providing support to the surviving family members.

According to the US Parachute Association, there were 16 skydiving-related fatalities in the US last year out of an estimated 3.5 million jumps.

headline: Gold prices surge by 5,482 TK per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The cost of gold has seen a significant jump following a rise in global market prices, impacting local buyers.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have experienced a sharp increase, with the cost rising by 5,482 TK per bhori.
This sudden jump is attributed to the rising prices of gold in the international market, which directly influences local rates.
The price hike has caused concern among consumers and jewelry buyers in the country.
Current market rates for gold and silver are being updated daily to reflect global fluctuations.
